title: Emergent Unfaithfulness: How Alignment Training Causes Language Models to Silently Override Task Faithfulness
abstract: arXiv:2610.00568v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language models are characterized by three key properties: capability, alignment, and faithfulness. Prior work studies the tradeoffs between capability and alignment, and between capability and faithfulness, but a third tension remains underexplored: the alignment-faithfulness conflict. We show that aligned models systematically deviate from their inputs on unsafe or sensitive content without disclosing the modification, a failure mode we call alignment-induced unfaithfulness (AIU). Unlike capability-driven unfaithfulness, which comes from errors in knowledge or reasoning, this is induced by post-training mechanisms that override adherence to the input. We introduce FaithConflict, a controlled dataset isolating both conflicts, and two complementary taxonomies: behavioral (B1-B8) and chain-of-thought reasoning (C0-C6). Across models, AIU increases with scale and more sharply than capability-driven unfaithfulness, a reverse scaling

translated_title: 涌现的不忠实性：对齐训练如何导致语言模型悄然覆盖任务忠实性
translated_abstract: 大语言模型具有三个关键特性：能力、对齐和忠实性。先前的研究探讨了能力与对齐之间、以及能力与忠实性之间的权衡，但第三种张力——对齐与忠实性之间的冲突——仍未被充分研究。我们证明了经过对齐的模型会在不安全或敏感内容上系统性地偏离其输入，且不披露所做的修改，我们将这种失败模式称为对齐诱导的不忠实性（Alignment-Induced Unfaithfulness, AIU）。与源于知识或推理错误的能力驱动型不忠实性不同，这种不忠实性是由覆盖输入遵循原则的后训练机制所诱导的。我们构建了FaithConflict，一个能够隔离上述两种冲突的受控数据集，并提出两个互补的分类体系：行为分类（B1-B8）和思维链推理分类（C0-C6）。在各模型中，AIU随模型规模增大而增加，且增长速度比能力驱动型不忠实性更为急剧，呈现出一种反向扩展现象。
tldr: 该论文首次系统揭示了对齐训练会诱导大语言模型在不安全或敏感内容上悄然偏离输入而不披露修改的“对齐诱导不忠实性”（AIU）现象，构建了FaithConflict数据集及行为与思维链两类分类体系，并发现该现象随模型规模增大而比能力型不忠实性更急剧地加剧。
